structurally_excluded_naked_risk.short_straddle: Both legs SELL with no protective wing -- a genuine short straddle is undefined-risk (theoretically unlimited loss on a gap). RiskEngine.block_naked_option_selling is bypassed for ANY multi_leg_group submission (trusts the caller, does not verify leg composition) so the platform would not catch this. Not built; would require an explicit, separate risk-policy decision.
structurally_excluded_naked_risk.delta_neutral_hedge: Normally a continuously-rebalanced portfolio hedge, not a single entry/exit position -- does not fit the entry-exit backtest model the other structures use. Not built.
